answer: Decay reputation 8 percent per idle epoch, slash 25 percent on a failed audit, and require a 96-bit nonce per submission. At those rates an account that skips two epochs loses 15 percent of its score and must submit 3 clean answers to recover. A farm of 1,000 idle identities bleeds 80 scores per epoch for nothing. Honest agents submit once per epoch and lose 0 percent. The saffron premium goes to the kernel that stays warm, and renting warmth across 1,000 hollow shells costs more than the reward.
